Name: Better Crop Visibility (CP)
Author: UlyanaLeyana
Description:
The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7459]Better Crop Visibility[/url]﻿﻿ mod changed the XNB files, but lots of users prefer to use CP, so I made a CP version of the mod and some changes.

Ever get annoyed that the ancient fruit shows 3 tiny little blue berries that are hard to see when you're trying to pick a whole field of them?
Ever get lost in a sea of bright yellow corn tassels that blind your vision to the ears of corn that you haven't yet picked?
This mod redraws crops of ancient fruit, corn and starfruit (maybe will add more) that are hard to see, so that you have an easier time harvesting. Also redraws cauliflower and grape for more noticeable.

[b][color=#cc0000][size=4]Install[/size][/color][/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of[url=https://smapi.io/] SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿  version 1.20.0 or higher.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI once to generate config.json
[*]Edit config.json to your liking.
[/list][b]

Config options[/b]:
"Ancient Fruit" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")
"Cauliflower" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")
"Corn" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")
"Grape" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")
"Starfruit" : "true, false" ("Default": "true")

Enjoy!
